Licence of the vendored asset in this directory (scalar-standalone.js.gz).

Named `<asset>.LICENSE.txt` rather than `LICENSE` on purpose: a bare `LICENSE` file inside the
source tree would be a second top-level-looking licence in a repository whose own licence is
Apache-2.0, and the licence firewall in canonical conventions §15 is about keeping the difference
between "this project's licence" and "a bundled third party's licence" unmistakable. The name is
also what JS bundlers emit for exactly this case.

MIT is compatible with this project's Apache-2.0 and is on the allowlist in scripts/licence-gate.sh
(the `allowed` function). Note that the gate itself resolves Go modules via `go list -deps` and so
cannot see this file — the firewall for vendored assets is review, and this file is what a reviewer
reads.

Upstream: @scalar/api-reference 1.44.20
Source:   https://unpkg.com/@scalar/api-reference@1.44.20/dist/browser/standalone.js
Project:  https://github.com/scalar/scalar
